name: Kusakabe Akihiko
source:
Akihiko moves into a new house where he was supposed to start living with his wife and mother-in-law. There, he suddenly receives a text from his wife telling him that she has been having an affair with another man and to take care of her mother for her. To make matters worse, his work place finds out about the affair and he is forced to take a paid leave. 

Soon he finds himself living with three beautiful women: his mother-in-law, his aunt, and the wife of the man whom his wife cheated on him.
